amy_sales: Quick heads-up — Acme's privacy lead (Carla) wants the POC packet: CAIQ, DPA with deletion SLA, SCCs if possible, and confirmation on training-data use. Can someone own the questionnaire and deletion SLA clarifications?

mike_se: I can take the CAIQ. Short defaults for POC: Hosted keeps request+response payloads 30 days for debugging/abuse; backups kept up to 90 days. Dedicated can disable logs and supports BYOK; Private = customer-controlled.

carla_customer: For DSARs, can we trigger deletions via API and also get a signed deletion certificate? Need both for our audit.

nora_security: Yes, hosted exposes a bulk deletion endpoint and we produce a signed CSV report on request. Deletion job usually completes within 48-72 hours; backup purge may take longer (standard 90 days) unless you take Dedicated with expedited backup purge. We'll include a flow diagram in the CAIQ packet.

oliver_legal: On SCCs and DPA: we will execute EU SCCs after contracting. DPA prohibits using customer prompts/outputs to train public models; aggregated telemetry may be used for QoS improvements and is excluded in the DPA. If Acme requires no telemetry sampling, offer Dedicated with an opt-out and a commercial uplift.

vendor-risk-bot: VR ticket VR-2026-981 created for Acme POC. Due: 2026-07-01. Owners: mike_se, nora_security.

amy_sales: Plan: Mike + Nora deliver CAIQ answers + dataflow diagram and deletion API snippet by EOD; Oliver to draft SCC/DPA note. I'll package and send to Carla and schedule a 30-min walkthrough. Carla, anything else?

carla_customer: Please add a clear table mapping CAIQ controls to SOC2 controls and indicate where BYOK and no-log modes apply. Also confirm subprocessors notice period.

nora_security: We'll attach CAIQ+SOC2 mapping and state subprocessors: 30 days notice; written consent required if residency or purpose materially changes.

amy_sales: Thanks — will follow up with the packet.
